scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a city street from a rooftop patio area. The patio has a red brick floor and is surrounded by buildings on both sides. There are several large planters along the right side of the patio, filled with various plants and shrubs. A white door is visible on the left side of the patio, leading into a building. The sky is blue with some clouds.
